ValidationRule.description: OPS-242. Blocks Closed Won when a practice-level Account has no Clinical Email (the Portal Admin email). Scoped to Practice: it is populated on only 1 of 384 corps in prod. Inert while the field is blank.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot mark Closed Won: the Account is missing a Portal Admin Email (Clinical Email). Add it on the Close screen, or update the Account directly.
